name: dev-workflow-standard
description: Engineering harness: diagnose demands, consolidate scope, require specs before tasks, resolve and invoke specialist skills/executors, track execution state, require execution receipts and validation evidence, recover or replan on failure, and review PRs.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate engineering execution, not just task planning.
interface.longDescription: Dev Workflow Standard acts as an engineering harness for software delivery: diagnose and scope the demand, require specs before tasks, resolve the required specialist skill/plugin/tool or executor, verify runtime availability, actively invoke the selected capability, preserve handoff context, require an EXECUTION_RECEIPT and validation evidence before advancing, recover or replan on failure, and review PRs against specs, task and acceptance criteria. Product code remains the responsibility of dev-implementation-standard or another explicitly approved executor capability.
defaultPrompt: Use Dev Workflow Standard as the engineering harness for this demand.
Resolve and invoke the capabilities required to execute this approved task.
Continue this engineering workflow from the current execution state and evidence.
Review this result against the task, specs, execution receipt and acceptance criteria.
